title.en: 4 Oct 07:12 CST recheck: no new casualty split
title.ne: 4 Oct 07:12 CST: naya casualty split chaina
title.hi: 4 Oct 07:12 CST: naya casualty split nahi

body.zh: 新华社、gov.cn、日喀则简报及@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus无新吉隆伤亡。中方仍为9月5日18时：43死、519失联、2人获救。尼方仍为NDRRMA 9月26日19:00 #25：1453死、5285失踪、13795获救。交通厅网（9月28日）G216仍双向管制。美使馆道路告示仍为9月3日。
body.en: No new Gyirong casualty figure from Xinhua, gov.cn, Shigatse briefings, @XHNews or @CCTV_Plus. CN remains 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. NP remains NDRRMA 26 Sep 19:00 #25: 1453 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued. Transport bulletin of 28 Sep still lists G216 under two-way control. US Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep.
body.ne: Xinhua, gov.cn, Shigatse, @XHNews/@CCTV_Plus ma naya Gyirong casualty chaina. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. NP NDRRMA 26 Sep 19:00 #25: 1453/5285/13795. 28 Sep transport: G216 dui tira niyantran. US Embassy notice 3 Sep nai.
body.hi: Xinhua, gov.cn, Shigatse, @XHNews/@CCTV_Plus se naya Gyirong casualty nahi. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. NP NDRRMA 26 Sep 19:00 #25: 1453/5285/13795. 28 Sep transport: G216 dono disha niyantran. US Embassy notice 3 Sep hi.

title.zh: 交通厅9月28日：G216吉隆镇—国门仍双向管制
title.en: Transport dept 28 Sep: G216 Gyirong town–gate still both ways controlled
title.ne: Transport 28 Sep: G216 Gyirong town–gate dui tira niyantran
title.hi: Transport 28 Sep: G216 Gyirong town–gate dono disha niyantran

body.zh: 西藏自治区交通运输厅路网：G216 K3500+200（吉隆镇）—K3525+850（吉隆国门）自8月26日起双向交通管制，解除时间待定。无新伤亡。抢险通道不等于社会通车或口岸通关。
body.en: Xizang transport network: G216 K3500+200 (Gyirong town) to K3525+850 (gate) remains under two-way control since 26 Aug; lift time unset. No new casualties. Rescue track is not public traffic or port clearance.
body.ne: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200–K3525+850 26 Aug dekhi dui tira niyantran. Naya casualty chaina. Rescue bato sarwajanik hoina.
body.hi: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200–K3525+850 26 Aug se dono disha niyantran. Naya casualty nahi. Rescue path janta ke liye nahi.

body.zh: @NDRRMA_Nepal发布搜救与救援第25号。报道对照：1453死、5285失踪、21个安置点约1109人（拉苏瓦805）。9月23日后获救数未见更新，仍记13795。此后无更新的博特科西专报。
body.en: @NDRRMA_Nepal posted SAR situation report #25. Reports read 1453 dead, 5285 missing, about 1109 people in 21 holding centres (805 in Rasuwa). Rescued figure not updated after 23 Sep and remains 13795. No later Bhotekoshi bulletin.
body.ne: @NDRRMA_Nepal #25: 1453 mrit, 5285 harayeka, 21 kendra ma 1109 (Rasuwa 805). Uddar 13795. Pachi Bhotekoshi bulletin chaina.
body.hi: @NDRRMA_Nepal #25: 1453 mrit, 5285 lapata, 21 kendron mein 1109 (Rasuwa 805). Uddhar 13795. Baad Bhotekoshi bulletin nahi.

title.zh: 指挥部9月6日：截至9月5日18时43死519失联
title.en: Command 6 Sep: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing
title.ne: Command 6 Sep: 5 Sep 18:00 samma 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin
title.hi: Command 6 Sep: 5 Sep 18:00 tak 43 mrit, 519 lapata

body.zh: 人民日报引吉隆应急救援指挥部：43人遇难、519人失联、成功救出2人、遗物993件。外籍失联261人、23国。此后新华社与@XHNews未见更新伤亡。
body.en: People's Daily cites the Gyirong command: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued, 993 personal effects. 261 missing foreigners from 23 countries. No later casualty update from Xinhua or @XHNews.
body.ne: People's Daily: 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin, 2 uddar, 993 saman. Bideshi 261. Xinhua/@XHNews pachi naya casualty chaina.
body.hi: People's Daily: 43 mrit, 519 lapata, 2 uddhar, 993 saman. Videshi 261. Xinhua/@XHNews ke baad naya casualty nahi.

title.zh: 新华社9月5日：口岸上方堰塞湖已排空
title.en: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake above the port drained
title.ne: Xinhua 5 Sep: port mathi ko bandha tal khali
title.hi: Xinhua 5 Sep: port ke upar ka barrier lake khali

body.zh: 西藏应急管理部门：堰塞湖已排空，河道恢复正常过流，危险基本解除。此后无新堰塞湖通报。
body.en: Xizang emergency management: the lake has drained, the channel is flowing normally, and the hazard is largely eliminated. No later barrier-lake bulletin.
body.ne: Xizang emergency: tal khali, nadi sadharan, jokhim dherai kam. Pachi naya tal bulletin chaina.
body.hi: Xizang emergency: jheel khali, nadi normal, khatra lagbhag khatam. Baad mein naya jheel bulletin nahi.

body.zh: 轻型车辆与集装箱可通行，不建议夜间。无新伤亡。不是中方吉隆口岸恢复通关。
body.en: Light vehicles and containers allowed; night travel advised against. No new casualties. This is not reopening of the Chinese Gyirong Port.
body.ne: Halka sawari ra container; rat yatra nahos. Naya casualty chaina. Chiniya Gyirong port khuleko hoina.
body.hi: Halke vahan aur container; raat yatra nahin. Naya casualty nahi. Chini Gyirong port nahi khula.

title.zh: Samaya Post 10月3日：加尔奇—贝特拉瓦蒂重开

body.zh: 拉苏瓦与下游公路网重新连通。无新伤亡。不是口岸通关。
body.en: Rasuwa linked back toward the downstream road network. No new casualties. Not a port reopening.
body.ne: Rasuwa tala ko sadak sanjal ma jodiyo. Naya casualty chaina. Port hoina.
body.hi: Rasuwa niche ke sadak net se juda. Naya casualty nahi. Port nahi.

title.zh: NDRRMA 10月1日：搜救结束，转入核查失踪
title.en: NDRRMA 1 Oct: SAR ended; missing-person verification
title.ne: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj-uddar sakiyo; harayeka jaanch
title.hi: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj-uddhhar khatam; lapata satyapan

body.zh: 报道称博特科西—特里舒利搜救结束、进入恢复并核查失踪。未给新的死伤总数，KPI仍用#25。
body.en: Reports say Bhotekoshi–Trishuli SAR has ended and recovery plus missing verification has begun. No new death total; KPI stays on #25.
body.ne: Bhotekoshi–Trishuli khoj sakiyo, missing jaanch. Naya death total chaina; KPI #25.
body.hi: Bhotekoshi–Trishuli khoj khatam, missing jaanch. Naya death total nahi; KPI #25.

title.zh: 美国驻尼使馆9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi–Timure
title.en: US Embassy Nepal 3 Sep: do not travel Rasuwagadhi–Timure
title.hi: US Embassy 3 Sep: Rasuwagadhi–Timure mat jao

body.zh: 使馆道路告示：勿前往Rasuwagadhi–Timure–Syafrubesi。尼方已部分重开该段，使馆未见更新告示。
body.en: Embassy road notice: do not travel to Rasuwagadhi–Timure–Syafrubesi. Nepal partly reopened the stretch; no newer embassy notice found.
body.ne: Embassy: Rasuwagadhi–Timure–Syafrubesi najau. Nepal le kehi kholyo; naya embassy notice chaina.
body.hi: Embassy: Rasuwagadhi–Timure–Syafrubesi mat jao. Nepal ne kuch khola; naya embassy notice nahi.

title.en: ReliefWeb cites NDRRMA 21 Sep: 1411 dead, 5875 missing

body.zh: IFRC DREF更新引用9月21日NDRRMA：1411死、5875失踪、13784获救。已被#25取代。未见新的UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS产品。
body.en: IFRC DREF update cites NDRRMA 21 Sep: 1411 dead, 5875 missing, 13784 rescued. Superseded by #25. No new UNOSAT or Copernicus EMS product found.
body.ne: IFRC DREF: 21 Sep NDRRMA 1411/5875/13784. #25 le badliyo. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS chaina.
body.hi: IFRC DREF: 21 Sep NDRRMA 1411/5875/13784. #25 ne badla. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS nahi.

detail.zh: 口岸设施已毁，通关未恢复。中方关闭。
detail.en: Port facilities destroyed; clearance not restored. Chinese side closed.
detail.ne: Port dhvasta; clearance khuleko chaina. Chiniya taraf band.
detail.hi: Port dhvast; clearance nahi. Chini taraf band.

detail.zh: 交通厅9月28日路网：K3500+200—K3525+850双向管制，解除时间待定。抢险通道仅救援。
detail.en: Transport bulletin 28 Sep: K3500+200–K3525+850 two-way control, lift time unset. Rescue track only.
detail.ne: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200–K3525+850 dui tira niyantran. Rescue bato matra.
detail.hi: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200–K3525+850 dono disha niyantran. Rescue path hi.

detail.zh: CDO 10月2日：轻车与集装箱可通，夜间不建议。非口岸通关。
detail.en: CDO 2 Oct: light vehicles and containers; avoid night. Not port clearance.
detail.ne: CDO 2 Oct: halka sawari/container; rat nahos. Port hoina.
detail.hi: CDO 2 Oct: halke vahan/container; raat nahin. Port nahi.

detail.zh: 截至9月5日18时：2500余人、核心区搜寻与消杀已覆盖。无新现场坐标。
detail.en: As of 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ personnel; core search and disinfection covered. No new live GNSS.
detail.ne: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ jana; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ log; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 10月1日报道称现场搜救结束、核查失踪。无新队伍坐标，故不标经纬度。
detail.en: 1 Oct reports say field SAR ended and missing persons are being verified. No new team GNSS, so no lat/lng.
detail.ne: 1 Oct: field khoj sakiyo, missing jaanch. Toli GNSS chaina, lat/lng chaina.
detail.hi: 1 Oct: field khoj khatam, missing jaanch. Team GNSS nahi, lat/lng nahi.

detail.zh: 9月5日指挥部：核心区搜寻与预防性消杀已全覆盖。
detail.en: 5 Sep command: core-area search and preventive disinfection fully covered.
detail.ne: 5 Sep command: core khoj ra disinfection cover.
detail.hi: 5 Sep command: core khoj aur disinfection cover.

detail.zh: 8月30日发布会：转移安置吉隆镇、萨勒乡5村499人。未见更新。
detail.en: 30 Aug briefing: 499 people from Gyirong town and Sale township relocated. No update.
detail.ne: 30 Aug: Gyirong town/Sale 5 gaun 499 sthanantran. Update chaina.
detail.hi: 30 Aug: Gyirong town/Sale 5 gaon 499 sthanantran. Update nahi.

status.zh: 堰塞湖已排空，河道正常过流（新华社9月5日）
status.en: Barrier lake drained; channel flowing normally (Xinhua 5 Sep)
status.ne: Bandha tal khali; nadi sadharan (Xinhua 5 Sep)
status.hi: Barrier lake khali; nadi normal (Xinhua 5 Sep)

text.zh: 拉苏瓦-博特科西洪水搜救救援第25号，9月26日19:00。此后无更新帖。
text.en: Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi SAR situation report #25, 26 Sep 19:00. No later post.
text.ne: Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi khoj pratibedan #25, 26 Sep 19:00. Pachi post chaina.
text.hi: Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi khoj report #25, 26 Sep 19:00. Baad post nahi.

text.zh: 国家气候中心向尼泊尔提供滚动气候监测与预报，支持吉隆—拉苏瓦口岸泥石流救援。无新伤亡。
text.en: National Climate Center providing Nepal rolling climate monitoring for Gyirong–Rasuwa mudslide relief. No new casualties.
text.ne: Climate Center le Nepal lai Gyirong–Rasuwa anuman. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Climate Center Nepal ko Gyirong–Rasuwa forecast. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: 国家气候中心向尼泊尔提供滚动气候监测，支持吉隆—拉苏瓦口岸泥石流救援。
text.en: National Climate Center giving Nepal rolling climate products for Gyirong–Rasuwa mudslide relief.
text.ne: Climate Center le Nepal lai Gyirong–Rasuwa uddar ko lagi climate anuman.
text.hi: Climate Center Nepal ko Gyirong–Rasuwa uddhar ke liye climate forecast.

text.zh: 灾后留在吉隆镇的尼泊尔工人继续工作，希望灾区尽快恢复。无新伤亡。
text.en: Nepali workers remaining in Gyirong Town continue work and hope for recovery. No new casualties.
text.ne: Gyirong Town ma Nepali karmi le kaam gare. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Gyirong Town mein Nepali karmchari kaam jaari. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: 志愿者在吉隆县向受灾群众与滞留尼泊尔公民发放免费餐食。无新伤亡。
text.en: Volunteers handing out free meals to affected residents and stranded Nepalis in Gyirong County. No new casualties.
text.ne: Gyirong ma swayamsevak le bhojan baade. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Gyirong mein swayamsevak bhojan de rahe. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: 新华社汇总吉隆口岸泥石流与中方救援进展。未给出超过9月5日的新伤亡。
text.en: Xinhua roundup of the Gyirong Port mudslide and Chinese rescue. No casualty figure later than 5 Sep.
text.ne: Xinhua Gyirong Port saransh. 5 Sep pachi naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Xinhua Gyirong Port roundup. 5 Sep ke baad naya casualty nahi.
